metrics.name: opportunity_score
metrics.business_definition: Propensity score (0 to 100) indicating an existing ICE vehicle owner's likelihood and urgency to transition to an electric vehicle (EV).
metrics.formula: Additive formula capped between 0 and 100: (1) Contract Expiry: Kiralama/Finans ending within 90 days = +30 pts; ending within 91-180 days = +20 pts; expired within past 180 days = +10 pts; expired > 180 days = 0 pts. (2) Kasko Renewal: Kasko ending within 60 days = +5 pts. (3) Vehicle Age: > 4.0 years = +25 pts; 3.0-4.0 years = +15 pts. (4) Maintenance Spend: Historical spend > 30,000 TL = +20 pts; 15,000-30,000 TL = +10 pts. (5) Service Recency: No workshop visit in > 365 days = +15 pts. (6) Brand EV Availability: BMW, MINI, or Jaguar in portfolio = +10 pts. (7) Unknown Fuel Vehicle Flag: has_unknown_vehicle adds 0 pts (flag only). Final score = min(100, max(0, sum(points))).

metrics.name: overall_dq_score
metrics.business_definition: Composite data quality and governance index measuring dataset trustworthiness and readiness across Bronze and Silver layers.
metrics.formula: overall_dq_score = 0.40 * validity_pct + 0.35 * completeness_pct + 0.25 * uniqueness_pct, where validity_pct is the compliance rate across non-null business domain validation rules (17-char VIN, valid dates 2015..2026-10-09, 10-digit 5xx phone, contract end >= start), completeness_pct measures non-missing attributes (excluding derived masked columns), and uniqueness_pct measures primary/business key distinctness.

metrics.name: ev_share_pct
metrics.business_definition: Electrification adoption rate representing the share of 100% battery-electric vehicle sales within total vehicle sales by dealership, brand, and calendar year.
metrics.formula: (ev_sales / total_sales) * 100. Computed at the dealer, brand, and calendar year level.

metrics.name: avg_annual_cost_per_vehicle_tl
metrics.business_definition: Normalized annual maintenance and repair cost per vehicle-year, allowing direct lifecycle cost comparison between electric and internal combustion vehicles.
metrics.formula: total_service_spend_tl / total_vehicle_years, where vehicle_years = (REFERENCE_DATE - sale_date) / 365.25. Excludes orphan vehicles lacking original sales date.

metrics.name: avg_cost_per_visit_tl
metrics.business_definition: Average invoice ticket value per workshop visit, segmented by brand and powertrain type.

metrics.name: retention_pct
metrics.business_definition: Secondary market residual value retention percentage comparing Borusan Next trade-in appraisal offers against original vehicle purchase prices across powertrains and brands.
metrics.formula: (avg_offer_tl / avg_sale_price_tl) * 100 for trade-in vehicles matched to original sales records by VIN.

metrics.name: unmatched_dim_vehicles_pct
metrics.business_definition: Referential integrity failure rate representing the percentage of silver fact table records whose VIN cannot be matched to dim_vehicles.

metrics.name: orphan_unmatched_sales_pct
metrics.business_definition: Percentage of fact table records with valid VINs whose sales transaction was quarantined, resulting in lack of sales lineage.

metrics.name: customer_match_precision
metrics.business_definition: Pairwise precision of rule-based customer entity resolution linking vehicle ownership records to golden customer clusters. Measured against SYNTHETIC ground truth (vin_to_customer.csv); quarantined records are not evaluated.
metrics.formula: true_positives / (true_positives + false_positives), evaluating pairwise vehicle-customer links against synthetic ground truth (quarantined records excluded).

metrics.name: customer_match_recall
metrics.business_definition: Pairwise recall of rule-based customer entity resolution measuring the proportion of true multi-vehicle customer ownership pairs successfully linked. Measured against SYNTHETIC ground truth (vin_to_customer.csv); quarantined records are not evaluated.
metrics.formula: true_positives / (true_positives + false_negatives), evaluating pairwise vehicle-customer links against synthetic ground truth (quarantined records excluded).

metrics.name: customer_match_f1
metrics.business_definition: Harmonic mean of pairwise precision and recall for customer entity resolution. Measured against SYNTHETIC ground truth (vin_to_customer.csv); quarantined records are not evaluated.
metrics.formula: 2 * (precision * recall) / (precision + recall), evaluating pairwise vehicle-customer links against synthetic ground truth (quarantined records excluded).

metrics.name: rejection_rate
metrics.business_definition: Data quarantine rate measuring the percentage of distinct incoming Bronze records removed from clean Silver processing due to domain validation or referential integrity failures.
metrics.formula: (distinct rejected bronze rows / bronze rows) * 100 per table. Evaluated distinct bronze rows quarantined with one or more rule failure events.

metrics.name: fuel_type_unknown_customers
metrics.business_definition: Count of customers in the operational fuel type verification queue who own exclusively vehicles with unknown powertrain type, queued for workshop data verification before EV qualification.
metrics.formula: Count of distinct customer records present in fuel_type_verification_queue (customers where all owned vehicles have fuel_type == 'UNKNOWN').
